title: Hölder Selections under Stieltjes Clocks: Uniform Disconnectedness and Jump Dominance
summary: It is known that, for ordinary Hölder multifunctions with 0 < α < 1, Hölder regularity alone does not guarantee the existence of a Hölder selection, and in general even a continuous selection may fail to exist. We ask how this situation changes when the parameter is measured through a Stieltjes clock. For 0 < α < 1, we characterize the clocks for which every compact-valued g-Hölder multifunction admits a g-Hölder selection.
